_what: e5 depth-hole diagnosis (docs/POST_5B_CHECKLIST.md e5): the right-hand wall region of node_a's D435if depth, in which the invalid-depth fraction (depth == 0) is computed for s06 / s07 / s08. Nowhere else.
_provenance: Defined 2026-10-08 from the pilot frames only (node_a s01_no_fire_d200 and s01_fire_d300, frame 0: RGB and the depth==0 mask), committed and pushed before any s06-s08 capture. Plain wall right of the radiator; excludes the floor and its diagonal skirting line, the flame position, the radiator, the dark wall fitting near the top and the image edges.
_coordinates: Normalized to the image (0 = left/top, 1 = right/bottom), half-open [x0, x1) x [y0, y1); depth is aligned to the colour frame (realsense_capture.py, rs.align to colour), so the same rectangle holds for both.
